title: Portal to the Garden
description: A young woman with blue-tipped hair and headphones stands in front of an open, gear-operated metallic vault door. She holds a selfie stick, looking back over her shoulder. The doorway reveals a vibrant, painterly garden with flowers and a distant cityscape under a purple sky, framed by giant white and red peonies.
prompt: A stylized digital painting of a young woman with blue hair and headphones standing in front of a large open mechanical vault door. She holds a selfie stick and looks back. Through the doorway is a colorful surreal garden with flowers and a city skyline at dusk. Giant white peonies and red flowers frame the scene against a black background, detailed gears and scattered picture frames on the ground, vibrant illustrative style
